fixed: A figure shorthand typed with a count over 64 beats, like `pbs (100)`, no longer expands to a figure with that many beats. The line is kept as a custom figure with your text, as for any other figure typed with such a count. A count of five digits or more, like `pbs (10000)`, is kept in the figure's note with the beats the shorthand was saved with.

Free-text entry no longer gives a one-figure shorthand a count outside the taxonomy's 0..64 beats range: the line is kept as a custom, as for a line with no shorthand. A count too long to be beats is read as a note on the figure (`splitShorthandCount(...).unread`) (#1879).
